title: The graph-plane projection map is C^2, with derivative at 0 of Hilbert-Schmidt size sqrt 2
statement: For natural numbers n, l let Pi : L(R^n, R^l) -> L(R^(n+l), R^(n+l)) send A to the orthogonal projection (starProjection) of R^(n+l) onto Gamma_A = span{graphPoint v (A v) : v in R^n}, both spaces carrying the operator norm. Then (1) Pi is C^2 (ContDiff R 2), and (2) for every H in L(R^n, R^l), hsNormSq (DPi(0)[H]) = 2 hsNormSq H, where DPi(0) = fderiv R Pi 0.
lean_statement: ∀ (n ℓ : ℕ), ContDiff ℝ 2 (fun A : Rn n →L[ℝ] Rn ℓ => (Submodule.span ℝ (Set.range fun v : Rn n => graphPoint v (A v))).starProjection) ∧ ∀ H : Rn n →L[ℝ] Rn ℓ, hsNormSq (fderiv ℝ (fun A : Rn n →L[ℝ] Rn ℓ => (Submodule.span ℝ (Set.range fun v : Rn n => graphPoint v (A v))).starProjection) 0 H) = 2 * hsNormSq H
